# Realtor Estates — Property in Nagpur

> Buy Your Estates, Build Your Legacy · Living Legacy Lifestyle. Curated NMRDA and Town Planning sanctioned residential and commercial plotted developments across Salai Dabha, Mouza Kanholi, Hingna, MIHAN, and Wardha Road in Nagpur, Maharashtra, India.

## Key Capabilities
- Interactive 3D WebGL master layout flythrough with camera rig spline choreography.
- Individual plot 360-degree pop-out 3D viewer with exact meter/feet dimensions, wide frontage road signage, live rotational true-north compass, and 3D allotted residence models on sold-out parcels.
- Live Maharashtra budget, stamp duty (including 5% women-buyer concession), registration, and Nagpur bank plot-loan EMI calculator (SBI Realty, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Bank of Baroda, Axis Bank, LIC HFL).
- Exclusive 14-Point Maharashtra Plot Buyer's Guide & Legal Checklist unlocked upon submitting an enquiry.

## Compliance & Privacy
- Personal owner/engineer details from sanction sheets are strictly redacted online for security.
- Prospective buyers are advised to independently verify original title deeds, current 7/12 (Satbara) extracts, NMRDA/NIT/NATP layout sanctions, NA orders, and applicable MahaRERA registrations before any financial commitment.
